title: #026. RPG Party Synergy Maximization
subtitle: Linearize pairwise hero synergy and rivalry products w_{ij} = x_i x_j using McCormick inequalities.
caseNames: 5-hero guild party with synergy and rivalry

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selected, pairProducts, totalValue }.
judge.m3: pairProducts[{p0}] for pair ({p1}, {p2}) received {p3}, expected x[{p1}] * x[{p2}] = {p4}.
judge.m4: Reported totalValue ({p0}) does not match computed total party power ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid party, but totalValue ({p0}) is below optimal ({p1}).
